The Path

Every day of the degree, in order.

8 semesters · 120 weeks · 540 days on the shared spine · 120 studio days · 5 live

How It Works

You do not have to decide what comes next. The Path is the whole degree laid out one day at a time: each week's days in the order you take them, Monday the books and Friday the Workshop, with the date each one publishes. Start at Day 0 and walk it. When a day is done, the end of the page points to the next one.

One week of the Path publishes every Monday, starting Monday, 4 January 2027. Every course in a semester advances together, so nobody gets ahead of their week and nobody falls behind it. Each semester ends at a gate, where you answer the same questions again and see what changed.
